# TypeSafeAI Community

> Unofficial community for TypeSafe AI and Jev, created by VC Moderator @BunsDev. Not the official TypeSafe AI team.

## Start here

- [Community profile and project directory](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md)
- [Developer and agent documentation](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/.github/blob/main/docs/discovery/README.md)
- [Repository instructions](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/.github/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Sharing and metadata checklist](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/.github/blob/main/docs/discovery/SHARING.md)
- [Screenshot evidence protocol](https://github.com/TypeSafeAI/.github/blob/main/docs/discovery/SCREENSHOTS.md)

## Boundaries

Follow each project's scoped instructions and actual manifests. This navigation does not grant authorization, override runtime policy, or establish model correctness. Preserve licenses, attribution, and the distinction between synthetic demonstrations and measured live evidence. Official product support belongs with the official TypeSafe AI team.
